before.title: Throughput regression
before.message: Median step time over the last 80 points (0.00909 s/step) is 2.94x the early-run baseline (0.003088 s/step, first 80 points), derived from step_time.
fixes: Check for a dataloader/IO bottleneck (e.g. a slow shard, network storage stall, growing prefetch queue).
Check for memory pressure/fragmentation causing more frequent allocator work or CPU-GPU sync.
Check other processes on the same GPU/host, or a thermal/power throttling event.
If a sequence-length or batch-size curriculum increases work per step by design, this may be expected -- not a regression.
